params.name: creatorId
params.description: Unique identifier of the board export job creator.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor-paginated method returns a portion of the total set of results based on the limit specified and a cursor that points to the next portion of the results. To retrieve the next portion of the collection, set the cursor parameter equal to the cursor value you received in the response of the previous request.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per call. If the number of jobs in the response is greater than the limit specified, the response returns the cursor parameter with a value.

info.name: Get board export job tasks list

params.name: org_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the organization.

params.name: job_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the board export job.

params.name: status
params.description: Filters the list of board export tasks by their status. Accepts an array of statuses such as TASK_STATUS_CREATED, TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED, TASK_STATUS_SCHEDULED, TASK_STATUS_SUCCESS or TASK_STATUS_ERROR.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor-paginated method returns a portion of the total set of results based on the limit specified and a cursor that points to the next portion of the results. To retrieve the next portion of the collection, set the cursor parameter equal to the cursor value you received in the response of the previous request.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per call. If the number of tasks in the response is greater than the limit specified, the response returns the cursor parameter with a value.
